title: 老樣子
subject: A woman who studies her hand-shaken tea shop's sixty-item menu board for five minutes every evening while the queue sighs, then orders the same light-sugar, no-ice Four Seasons oolong as always, until the clerk laminates a one-item menu just for her.
caption: Mandarin chiptune pop, bouncy 8-bit game-console dance pulse. Square-wave pulse lead playing a plucky staccato hook, triangle-wave bass on the roots, noise-channel snare and closed hats over a light kick, fast pulse-wave arpeggios in the chorus, bell-like wavetable chime in the pre-chorus. Crisp bright console-style mix, clean and unmuddied. Female vocal, light bright mid-register, playful, doubled in unison on the chorus. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 108 BPM, F major. Sunny, teasing, self-mocking mood. No rap, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no heavy EDM drop, no vocal effects, no orchestral samples.
lyrics:
[Intro - pulse lead, noise hats, triangle bass]

[Verse 1]
每天傍晚六點半
我站在飲料店門口
六十個名字 排滿牆
我從第一行 慢慢看

[Chorus]
我要 微糖去冰
一杯四季春茶
看了五分鐘 還是
老樣子 老樣子

[Verse 2]
店員在櫃檯後面笑
他說 小姐你點過了
一百二十天 都一樣
可是今天 說不定

[Pre-Chorus]
黑板上寫著新品
我的手指停在半空

[Chorus]
我要 微糖去冰
一杯四季春茶
後面的人 嘆口氣
我還是 老樣子

[Bridge - pulse lead, chime]
他轉身去拿護貝機
一張小卡片 熱熱的

[Chorus]
店裡只有 一行字
微糖去冰 四季春茶
我看了零秒 就說
老樣子 老樣子

[Outro - pulse lead, noise hats fade]
後面的人 終於笑了
